component_versions.policy: pinned at build time; scripts/miami_readiness.py marks this package STALE when any pinned layer republishes

units.area: sq ft / acres / sq mi (display), m2 (internal)
units.density: persons per sq mi, jobs per acre, households per acre

ai_usage_rules.site_facts: cite evidence_id from the layer evidence files named in evidence_source; do not restate or invent sources
ai_usage_rules.normative_judgements: cite rule_id + knowledge-base document version (to be pinned in the rules/KB stage)
ai_usage_rules.option_comparisons: cite calculation result ids from the scenarios/rules stage
forbidden: treating density or accessibility as persons/hour
using coverage shares as allocation weights
reading LODES counts as trips or ridership
inferring willingness to pay from income

readers: AI layer (batch reasoning; cite evidence ids)
deterministic configuration rules (read config_inputs + scenario results)

role_classification.note: role-based classification is an analysis-layer output of the V2 pivot; the data layer records facts only

zoning.source: City of Miami M21 zoning (CC-BY-4.0) joined in EPSG:26917
zoning.semantics: statutory zoning = permitted/constrained use; NOT observed land use, population, jobs or demand; no use mapping; no exclusion; coverage shares are NOT allocation weights
zoning.uncovered_note: uncovered = not in the zoning layer; may be water, right-of-way, layer gaps or unrecorded parcels — cause not determined here
zoning.shares_note: per-code shares are unions within each code; they need not sum to zoned_area_share when codes overlap (overlap_excess = repeat-counted area; conflict_union = actual area covered by >=2 codes)
zoning.small_fragment_note: tiny fragments are kept for audit; they must not be read as meaningful use or demand

areal_interpolation.note: shares assume the block group's estimate is spread evenly over its LAND; this is an assumption, and the MOE shown excludes it

school.name: KLA Schools of Brickell
school.note: straight line from the reference point; not a walking distance

clinic.name: JHS - Downtown Medical Center
clinic.note: straight line from the reference point; not a walking distance

grocery.name: Whole Foods Market 10191
grocery.note: straight line from the reference point; not a walking distance

park.name: Fort Dallas Park
park.note: straight line from the reference point; not a walking distance

poi_nearest_by_category.note: straight-line distances, not walking distances; absence = not found in the sources inside the window

point_zoning_match.note: A reference point not covered by any zoning polygon (e.g. in right-of-way) does not invalidate the band profile and does not imply the station is unlawful or without demand; no nearest-neighbour fill is applied.

od_link_potential.note: Σ S000 × (share of the end block's land inside the station's half-mile disc); NON-exclusive across stations, not an allocation, not trips; station-to-station allocation with conservation checks is an analysis-layer task
excludes: Florida residents working out of state

configuration.note: configuration is an output of the rules stage; kept here as the NOT_CALCULATED placeholder

ridership_baseline.content: Metromover boardings/alightings by station and hour
ridership_baseline.note: published boardings of the CURRENT Metromover per average weekday (DTPW); not trips, not OD, not alightings, not peak hour; an observed reference for scale and station-share shape, never a calibration target for the scenarios

service_baseline.content: scheduled headways by period per station
service_baseline.note: scheduled, not operated; not capacity; not ridership

hub_transfer_inflow.content: transfer entrances and volumes from Metrorail, Brightline etc.
hub_transfer_inflow.scope_decision: kept as a field, NOT modeled in the Miami V2 case (Melbourne covers hub inflow); results cannot prove full-line replacement capacity under all existing demand

road_guideway_roles.content: road function, vertical level, mode, truck restrictions per segment

platform_constructible_space.content: platform footprint and constructible space per station

value.statement: the selected module's footprint is assumed to be constructible at every station; the per-station constructible space has NOT been acquired, so this assumption stands in for it

platform_constructible_space.note: per-station constructible space has NOT been acquired; the module footprint is assumed available so the configuration chain can run

vehicle_parameters.note: geometry fit is an owner statement; operating values are generic PRT assumptions, replaceable by specified values

platform_module_specification.content: station platform modules as drawn: layout, berths, footprint
platform_module_specification.source: project owner, as two dimensioned isometric drawings (one in feet-inches, one in metres)

modules.layout: through guideway in the middle; angled berths on both sides
through guideway along one edge; angled berths in one row

value.canonical_units: imperial as drawn (feet-inches); metric derived exactly with 0.3048 m per ft; the metric drawing's own values are kept verbatim under metric_drawing_as_provided and differ from the exact conversion by up to about 0.6 %
value.vehicle_fit_statement: owner statement 2026-09-17: vehicles fit entirely within the berths as drawn, so vehicle dimensions are not needed for platform geometry
not_specified_in_drawings: berth entry/exit geometry and switch clearances
whether modules can be combined at one station

walk_model.note: optional for AI interpretation; listed in readiness ai_missing_optional
